dropped.item: "guidance you can trust": the trust/credibility framing of the opening line
"always" and "right" in "so you always know what to do and how to do it right"; the edit says only "so you know what to do and how to do it"
"to unlock more of what the app has to offer": the statement that Premium unlocks additional features is softened to "If you want more"
"billed monthly" wording replaced by "costs $7.99 per month", so the explicit billing cadence is implied rather than stated

changed.item: "Every video is filmed by a licensed physical therapist" became "A licensed physical therapist films every one", which could be read as a single therapist filming all videos
"working on strength and mobility" became "just building strength and mobility"; adding "just" slightly downplays this use case
"proper form and technique" became "exactly how each movement should look"; "exactly" adds a slightly stronger certainty

added.item: "Recovering at home is easier when you know you're doing the exercises right": a new framing claim that recovery is easier
Header "WHY PEOPLE USE STEPWISE" implies an existing user base, which the original does not claim
"simple, clear routines": the exercises are recast as "routines"
